# The Delegation Divide — Agent Delegability Index (ADI)

> Open index of AI-agent delegability for 436 ISCO-08 occupations and 190 countries (v2026.1).
> Three layers per task: augmentation, partial delegation, full delegation. Scored by four frontier
> models, validated against 1,500 human-rated tasks. Headline number in README.md and claims.jsonl.

## How to use
- Occupation lookup: `datos/salidas/adi_isco08.csv` or JSON `adi/v2026.1/isco/<code>.json`
- Country atlas: `datos/salidas/adi_countries.csv`
- MCP server: `adi-mcp` (tools: lookup_occupation, country_profile, cite)
- Python: `pip install adi-index`

## How to cite
See CITATION.cff. BibTeX key: espinal2026delegation.

## Files
- README.md: summary, headline, BibTeX
- docs/PLAN.md: full design
- articulo/claims.jsonl: every number in the paper, with the script that produces it
